article.body: Guidance released by Dstl on September 28, 2026, provides essential information for organizations working or aiming to work across civil and defence space. The guidance covers topics such as ESA’s industrial policy, current activity, and programs, as well as basics of ESA procurement and navigation through ESA STAR. This collaborative initiative is part of the Unlocking Space for Government – Defence programme. No timeline for implementation is announced.
